form.title: AIX Admin (L2)
responsibilities: Create and manage user accounts, groups, and permissions
Install, configure, and maintain AIX operating systems and servers.
Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of AIX infrastructure.
Perform regular system backups and restore operations.
Perform routine system maintenance tasks such as applying patches, firmware updates, and security fixes
Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues on AIX platforms.
Implement and manage system security and compliance measures.
Collaborate with other IT staff to integrate AIX systems with other network resources.
Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimize future incidents
Maintain documentation for system configurations, procedures, and tasks.
